# The Brain burn-in prints its receipt to the job log as well

## Context

Each `e2e-brain` shard writes its receipt only to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`, in the step "Report the shard's receipt" of `.github/workflows/test-e2e-brain.yml`. No agent can read that receipt:
- a job summary renders only on the run page, for signed-in users;
- `gh run view --log` does not contain it;
- the check-run API returns none of it: `gh api repos/neomjs/neo/check-runs/115024961806` gives an empty `output.summary`.

So no agent has read a receipt's text yet. The post-merge receipts on #19655 were rebuilt from the list reporter's log lines. #19682's post-merge item, that the receipt names each retried test with its first-attempt error, cannot be checked. On [run 38313618683](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38313618683), the first after that merge, `WorkstationTearOutSourceContinuityNL:614` healed on retry, and its receipt line is unreadable.

## The Fix

The step pipes the receipt through `tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"` under `set -o pipefail`. The step's default shell, `bash -e`, has no `pipefail`, so without it a receipt that throws would pass behind `tee`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each shard's job log contains its receipt verbatim, and the job summary is unchanged.
- [ ] A receipt that throws still fails its step.
- [ ] Post-merge: the next `dev` run's receipts are read from `gh run view --log`, including the retry line and every "Needed the retry" line.

## Out of Scope

- What the receipt says.

## Related

- #19682 (its post-merge item), epic #19655, #19657.
